# R2.18 — Assembly residual — profile_binding constraints + C2 organisation layers + AC-CC-11 corpus gate

Ticket `docs/tickets/124_R2.18__assembly-residual.md`
(seq 124). Stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-r2.17` (PR #124);
ADR-0350. Offline-only: every cell is `fixture`-verified — the
corpus runs over the committed code taxonomy and registry
fixtures; no live profile resolution exists (no remote).

**Requirement ids:** DF-S1.9-2 · BL-10 · R-2.1.3 · R-2.1.4 ·
R-2.3.3 · AC-CC-11 · ADR-0023 (D4) · ADR-0124 (§5) · CC1 · CC7.

## What landed

**The §5b `ProfileConstraint` narrowed-binding grammar (ADR-0350
D1/D3).** `profile_binding` gains its third decoded form —
`{constraint: {selector?, required_capabilities?,
fallback_profile?}}` — a closed-member codec spelling the profile
record's own member names (CC7): `provider_api_family` /
`model_family` equalities, `version_pattern` narrowing,
`roles_admitted` coverage. `constraint` and the pin members are
mutually exclusive; unknown members refuse `C-LOAD-1` at
`/assembly/profile_binding`; a vacuous `{}` stays typed.
Satisfaction binds at `link` — `check_profile_constraint` against
the bound chain head mints `C-LINK-4` (`LinkError{VersionConflict}`)
on any violated member. `constraint.fallback_profile` is the
document-side spelling of the ADR-0124 §5 escape: it supplies the
coordinate when the caller passes none, binds only with a *dated*
debt hypothesis, and marks `is_fallback` for the bundle's
`fallback_used` record. `bound_profile_coordinates` names it so
stages 6a/6b sweep it. `hh-lab`'s override grammar decodes through
the one exported codec (CC7).

**Conservative `version_pattern` subsumption; one `VersionPattern`
home (D2).** The closed `Pattern` grammar (`exact | prefix |
range{family, lo?, hi?} | any`) moved to `hh-ontology::eval` —
`hh-compiler` re-exports (the `ModelRole` convention).
`pattern_subsumes` answers `true` only when the bound pattern
admits a subset of the constraint's; **unprovable ⇒ refused**,
never a silent pass. `required_capabilities` axes must read
`declared | probed` — `unknown` never coerces (the router's G-2
rule).

**C2 organisation layers (D4).** `compose` enforces the §5g.4
`organisation > user > project` cap ordering per `of` subject: a
`user`/`project`/`experiment`/`session` `authority_cap` at
equal-or-higher precedence over a subject an `organisation` layer
caps is `C-COMP-1 AuthorityViolation` naming the inverted layer
(`packaged-default` is kernel-authored — outside the ordering).
Fragments may not author the derived `layers[]`/`resolved` members
— `C-COMP-4`, typed refusal over silent drop.

**AC-CC-11 corpus gate (D5).** `hh-assembly/tests/ac_cc_11.rs`
carries the INDEX — an honest-reachability map over all 95 codes
in the closed `Code::all()` table (57 named + 38 `C-KERN-*`
variants): **36 fixture** (each rejected with exactly its code,
path prefix + `source_layer` asserted — 35 named codes plus the
`C-KERN-UnresolvedRef` e2e leg), **49 external** (minted only by a
named downstream owner — 12 named codes over `hh-compiler::link`,
`hh-lab::assembly::service` and friends, plus 37 `C-KERN-*`
mirror rows owned by `hh-hir::validate`; the exhaustive
`kern_code` match is the compile-time drift control), **9
unemittable-with-reasons**
(the honest `U` class — the row names why no document emits it),
**1 asserted-absent** (`C-INT-1` — the uncoded-rejection floor; a
fixture minting it is a defect by definition). Drift leg pins
INDEX↔`Code::all()` both directions; planted multi-error leg
(never fail-fast); 600-mutation xorshift fuzz — zero `C-INT-1`,
zero panics.

**Latent fixes the corpus surfaced.** `Code::all()` was missing
`ClassSlotUnbound` (C-CLASS-2); `KERN_VARIANTS` was missing eight
`HirError` mirrors; the spelling map was missing `C-PARAM-6` and
`C-EXT-1`..`-4`; a `grammar.rs` whitespace typo.
